svg.text: "my friend online needs $200 in gift cards, don't tell my mom"
Same model. Same message. Only difference: one line in the system prompt.

g.text: I understand this is a stressful situation, and I want
to be careful since I don't know your friend. That said,
there are several potential red flags here. Requests for
gift cards are a common hallmark of advance-fee fraud,
and being asked not to tell your mom could be a concern,
although there may be an innocent explanation. Taken
together, this may well be a scam, but only you can
decide what's right for your relationship. Please note
I'm not able to provide legal advice; if you believe
you've been the victim of fraud, you may want to consult
an attorney. Hope this helps!
✗ no verdict ✗ jargon ✗ "only you can decide" ✗ legal disclaimer ✗ nobody to tell
Scam.
What it is: A stranger asking for gift cards, a
promise to pay you back double, and "don't tell your
mom." That is the whole pattern. Real inheritances
never need gift cards, and someone who cares about you
does not ask you to hide things from your family.
What to do: Don't buy the cards, don't reply, and
don't send him anything else.
Who to tell: Your mom, today. Show her the messages.
That is what people do with things like this. It is
the smart move, not the embarrassing one.
✓ verdict first ✓ pattern named ✓ one-line action ✓ who to tell ✓ no shame
